invariants.rationale: clusteringGroup is dereferenced in multiple places and passed to utility methods, so it must not be null.
strategyParams is used as a parameter and passed into performClusteringWithRecordList, so it cannot be null.
instantTime is used in various calls such as readRecordsForGroup and performClusteringWithRecordList, thus required to be non-null.
Number of output file groups for clustering is likely to be positive to proceed with clustering work.
getSlices() is used with stream(), so it must return a non-null collection.
